report:
Reassessed the complete claim and all three test entries against the ordinary operator.rs implementation association. Verified exact byte equality of current operator.rs, representation_spec.rs and binary_operators.rs against the supplied historical input; historical reasoning is consistent with the current fragments, not used as a substitute for examining them. check_binary_operator maps every overloadable binary token to its trait method, instantiates the signature, constructs ResolvedCall with the selected function, StaticTrait dispatch, Self/Rhs owner substitutions and empty method substitutions, allocates explicit receiver/argument adjustments and a result type, then retains proof obligations. Only lazy boolean operators take the Binary construction branch; missing/unsupported signatures produce errors. This supports retaining trait calls for primitive and user-defined cases without introducing primitive specialization here; the later concrete-codegen recognition clause is a phase boundary, not a claim that such codegen is implemented by this file.

All associated behavioral tests were read in full. comparisons_materialize_signature_required_shared_borrows requires completed calls for primitive u32 equality/ordering, checks method and trait identity, bool result, two shared Ref operands and shared-reference types. local_operator_impl_can_choose_distinct_rhs_and_output requires the completed custom addition call, add identity, retained distinct Self=Left/Rhs=Right substitutions and Sum output; diagnostics must be empty. Captured fixture source confirms those exact operations and local impl; captured assert_symbol_name verifies names and excludes unresolved use symbols. These tests directly reject Binary in the inspected completed cases. No field-by-field isolated test requirement is needed for their integrated evidence.

The associated sage_meta::todo::types_operators_trait_calls remains a justified explicit deferral: its empty body is not behavioral evidence. Generic operands and the full oracle/operator matrix are still pending. Completion requires generic trait-bound/operator proof and normalization support sufficient to produce completed calls, then oracle-backed coverage of those generic scenarios and remaining operator combinations with identity, substitutions, adjustments and result assertions. The existing ground examples do not establish that universal matrix. Approval here preserves that visible TODO rather than claiming universal implementation or coverage.

Method: source inspection, captured supporting reads and exact historical-byte comparison. Personally executed review start/read commands (one out-of-bounds read failed and was corrected) and am recording this report; no behavioral tests or build were run by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported 321 sage-meta tests and cargo build are separate baseline execution, not evidence of operator test execution. No concrete discrepancy or additional edit was identified.
